Fields.Name: Enable Bone Weights
Fields.Description:
Determines how the mesh is skinned. If it is true the mesh is assumed to be in bind pose and is skinned using the FLVER.Vertex.BoneIndices and FLVER.Vertex.BoneWeights of the vertices.

If it is false each FLVER.Vertex specifies a single node to bind to using its FLVER.Vertex.NormalW.

The mesh is assumed to not be in bind pose and the transform of the bound node is applied to each vertex.

Fields.Name: Dynamic
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the mesh is already in bind pose or not, among other things (probably).

Fields.Name: Material Index
Fields.Description: Index in the flver's material list to apply to this mesh.

Fields.Name: Node Index
Fields.Description: Index of the node representing this mesh in the nodes list.

Fields.Name: Bone Indices
Fields.Description: Indexes of bones in the bone collection which may be used by vertices in this mesh.

Fields.Name: Vertices
Fields.Description: Points making up the mesh's shape.
